description: The words a bill's sections need, for each policy and law series on the bill catalog (src/core2/data/legislature/bill-catalog.json): the subject as a noun phrase, the purpose as a verb phrase and the operative clause an ordinance or act enacts, with the form of each kind of bill (an ordinance's number, enacting words, sections and effective date; an act's). Authored at development time by the Words line to the patterns of real bill titles and ordinance sections ('An ordinance to ...', 'Be it ordained ..., That ...'); copied from no one. Graded in a words batch like any line. A policy the catalog adds needs a row here; src/english/bill-sections.test.ts fails until it has one. A bill's name is a separate piece (bill-names.json).
author: Claude Sonnet (Words line, claude/words-bill-name-and-text)

ordinance.title: An ordinance to {purpose}.
ordinance.repealTitle: An ordinance to repeal the town's rules on {subject}.
ordinance.further: Section {number}. And be it further ordained, That {text}.
ordinance.repeal: the rules now in force on {subject} are repealed and shall have no further effect

effective.on-enactment: This ordinance takes effect on the day it is adopted.
effective.days-after-adoption: This ordinance takes effect {days} days after it is adopted.
effective.state-rule: This ordinance takes effect as state law provides.

act.title: A bill for an act to {purpose}.
act.repealTitle: A bill for an act to repeal the law on {subject}.
act.further: Section {number}. And be it further enacted, That {text}.
act.repeal: the law now in force on {subject} is repealed

effective.on-enactment: This Act takes effect on the day it is enacted.
effective.days-after-adoption: This Act takes effect {days} days after it is enacted.
effective.state-rule: This Act takes effect as state law provides.

transportation-infrastructure.fare-free-.subject: free fares on public transit
transportation-infrastructure.fare-free-.purpose: make public transit free to ride
transportation-infrastructure.fare-free-.enact: no fare shall be charged for riding the public transit service

transportation-infrastructure.mileage-fe.subject: a mileage fee in place of the fuel tax
transportation-infrastructure.mileage-fe.purpose: replace the fuel tax with a fee on miles driven
transportation-infrastructure.mileage-fe.enact: a fee on each mile driven shall be charged in place of the tax on motor fuel

transportation-infrastructure.public-bro.subject: public broadband service
transportation-infrastructure.public-bro.purpose: build and run a public broadband network
transportation-infrastructure.public-bro.enact: a public broadband network shall be built and operated for the residents it serves

transportation-infrastructure.shift-high.subject: highway money used for transit
transportation-infrastructure.shift-high.purpose: move highway money into public transit
transportation-infrastructure.shift-high.enact: money set aside for highways shall be spent on public transit

health-human-services.expand-medicaid-el.subject: wider Medicaid eligibility
health-human-services.expand-medicaid-el.purpose: extend Medicaid coverage to more residents
health-human-services.expand-medicaid-el.enact: Medicaid coverage shall be open to every resident whose income falls below the expanded limit

health-human-services.medicaid-work-requ.subject: a work requirement for Medicaid
health-human-services.medicaid-work-requ.purpose: require work or training for adults on Medicaid
health-human-services.medicaid-work-requ.enact: an adult shall show work or training hours to keep Medicaid coverage

health-human-services.work-requirement-f.subject: a work requirement for cash assistance
health-human-services.work-requirement-f.purpose: require work or training for adults who receive cash assistance
health-human-services.work-requirement-f.enact: an adult shall show work or training hours to keep receiving cash assistance

education.universal-preschool.subject: free preschool for every child
education.universal-preschool.purpose: offer free preschool to every young child
education.universal-preschool.enact: a free preschool place shall be offered to every child of preschool age

education.public-funds-for-private-schoo.subject: public money for private schooling
education.public-funds-for-private-schoo.purpose: let public money follow a child to a private school
education.public-funds-for-private-schoo.enact: public education money shall pay part of a child's tuition at a private school

education.raise-teacher-minimum-salary.subject: a higher minimum teacher salary
education.raise-teacher-minimum-salary.purpose: raise the lowest salary a school may pay a teacher
education.raise-teacher-minimum-salary.enact: no teacher in a public school shall be paid less than the new minimum salary

fiscal.adopt-income-tax.subject: an income tax
fiscal.adopt-income-tax.purpose: levy a tax on residents' income
fiscal.adopt-income-tax.enact: a tax shall be levied on the income of residents

fiscal.cap-property-tax-growth.subject: a limit on property tax growth
fiscal.cap-property-tax-growth.purpose: limit how fast property tax bills may rise
fiscal.cap-property-tax-growth.enact: the amount raised by the property tax shall not grow faster than the limit set here

fiscal.exempt-groceries-from-sales-tax.subject: a sales tax exemption for groceries
fiscal.exempt-groceries-from-sales-tax.purpose: take groceries out of the sales tax
fiscal.exempt-groceries-from-sales-tax.enact: food bought for eating at home shall be exempt from the sales tax

fiscal.graduated-income-tax.subject: a graduated income tax
fiscal.graduated-income-tax.purpose: tax higher incomes at higher rates
fiscal.graduated-income-tax.enact: income shall be taxed at rates that rise with the amount earned

fiscal.balanced-operating-budget.subject: a balanced operating budget
fiscal.balanced-operating-budget.purpose: require spending not to exceed revenue in the operating budget
fiscal.balanced-operating-budget.enact: the operating budget shall not spend more than the revenue expected for the year

fiscal.fund-pensions-to-schedule.subject: full pension funding on schedule
fiscal.fund-pensions-to-schedule.purpose: pay into the public pension fund on a fixed schedule
fiscal.fund-pensions-to-schedule.enact: the full pension payment due each year shall be paid into the pension fund

fiscal.minimum-reserve-balance.subject: a minimum reserve balance
fiscal.minimum-reserve-balance.purpose: keep a minimum reserve in the treasury
fiscal.minimum-reserve-balance.enact: a reserve of at least the set minimum shall be kept in the treasury

housing-land-use.allow-multifamily-in-si.subject: apartments in single-family zones
housing-land-use.allow-multifamily-in-si.purpose: allow apartment buildings in single-family zones
housing-land-use.allow-multifamily-in-si.enact: apartment buildings shall be allowed in zones now limited to single-family houses

housing-land-use.inclusionary-requiremen.subject: affordable homes in new buildings
housing-land-use.inclusionary-requiremen.purpose: require new housing developments to include affordable homes
housing-land-use.inclusionary-requiremen.enact: a new housing development shall set aside a share of its homes at rents within reach of lower incomes

housing-land-use.rent-stabilization.subject: limits on rent increases
housing-land-use.rent-stabilization.purpose: limit how much a landlord may raise the rent each year
housing-land-use.rent-stabilization.enact: a landlord shall not raise the rent in a year by more than the limit set here

housing-land-use.right-to-counsel-in-evi.subject: a lawyer for tenants facing eviction
housing-land-use.right-to-counsel-in-evi.purpose: give tenants facing eviction the right to a lawyer
housing-land-use.right-to-counsel-in-evi.enact: a tenant facing eviction shall be provided a lawyer at no charge

labor-commerce.raise-federal-minimum-wag.subject: a higher federal minimum wage
labor-commerce.raise-federal-minimum-wag.enact: the federal minimum wage shall be raised to the amount set here

labor-workforce.local-minimum-wage-autho.subject: local control of the minimum wage
labor-workforce.local-minimum-wage-autho.purpose: let cities set their own minimum wage
labor-workforce.local-minimum-wage-autho.enact: a city shall have the power to set a minimum wage higher than the state's

labor-workforce.raise-minimum-wage.subject: a higher minimum wage
labor-workforce.raise-minimum-wage.enact: no worker shall be paid less than the new minimum wage

labor-workforce.paid-family-leave.subject: paid family leave
labor-workforce.paid-family-leave.purpose: give workers paid leave to care for a new child or a sick relative
labor-workforce.paid-family-leave.enact: a worker shall be paid during leave taken to care for a new child or a sick relative

labor-workforce.public-sector-collective.subject: collective bargaining for public employees
labor-workforce.public-sector-collective.purpose: let public employees bargain together over pay and conditions
labor-workforce.public-sector-collective.enact: public employees shall have the right to bargain together over their pay and working conditions

labor-workforce.right-to-work.subject: workers who do not join a union
labor-workforce.right-to-work.purpose: bar contracts that make workers pay a union to hold a job
labor-workforce.right-to-work.enact: no worker shall be required to join or pay a union as a condition of holding a job

business-commerce.legalize-cannabis-sale.subject: legal cannabis sales
business-commerce.legalize-cannabis-sale.purpose: allow licensed shops to sell cannabis to adults
business-commerce.legalize-cannabis-sale.enact: a licensed shop may sell cannabis to adults

business-commerce.cap-consumer-loan-rate.subject: a limit on consumer loan rates
business-commerce.cap-consumer-loan-rate.purpose: cap the interest a lender may charge on consumer loans
business-commerce.cap-consumer-loan-rate.enact: a lender shall not charge more than the set rate of interest on a consumer loan

environment-energy.ban-new-gas-hookups.subject: new gas hookups in buildings
environment-energy.ban-new-gas-hookups.purpose: bar new natural gas hookups in buildings
environment-energy.ban-new-gas-hookups.enact: a new building shall not be connected to the natural gas system

environment-energy.clean-electricity-sta.subject: clean electricity
environment-energy.clean-electricity-sta.purpose: require utilities to supply a rising share of power from clean sources
environment-energy.clean-electricity-sta.enact: each utility shall supply a rising share of its power from clean sources

environment-energy.clean-air-plan-for-po.subject: a clean air plan for polluted areas
environment-energy.clean-air-plan-for-po.purpose: require a plan to cut air pollution where the air is worst
environment-energy.clean-air-plan-for-po.enact: an area where the air falls short of the standard shall adopt a plan to cut pollution

environment-energy.bottle-deposit.subject: a deposit on bottles and cans
environment-energy.bottle-deposit.purpose: put a refundable deposit on drink bottles and cans
environment-energy.bottle-deposit.enact: a refundable deposit shall be charged on every drink bottle and can sold

environment-energy.price-carbon.subject: a price on carbon
environment-energy.price-carbon.purpose: put a price on carbon pollution
environment-energy.price-carbon.enact: a charge shall be paid on each ton of carbon released

justice-public-safety.civilian-oversight.subject: civilian oversight of police
justice-public-safety.civilian-oversight.purpose: set up a civilian board to oversee the police
justice-public-safety.civilian-oversight.enact: a board of residents who are not police officers shall review complaints against the police

justice-public-safety.partner-with-feder.subject: cooperation with federal immigration enforcement
justice-public-safety.partner-with-feder.purpose: have local police work with federal immigration agents
justice-public-safety.partner-with-feder.enact: local police shall work with federal immigration agents on the cases they refer

justice-public-safety.end-cash-bail.subject: an end to cash bail
justice-public-safety.end-cash-bail.purpose: end the use of cash bail before trial
justice-public-safety.end-cash-bail.enact: no person shall be held before trial for lack of money to pay bail

justice-public-safety.restore-voting-aft.subject: voting rights after a sentence
justice-public-safety.restore-voting-aft.purpose: restore the vote to people who have finished their sentence
justice-public-safety.restore-voting-aft.enact: a person who has finished a sentence shall have the right to vote restored

justice-public-safety.raise-juvenile-cou.subject: a higher juvenile court age
justice-public-safety.raise-juvenile-cou.purpose: raise the age at which a person is tried as an adult
justice-public-safety.raise-juvenile-cou.enact: a person below the new age shall be handled in juvenile court

justice-public-safety.child-access-preve.subject: safe storage of firearms around children
justice-public-safety.child-access-preve.purpose: require firearms to be stored where children cannot reach them
justice-public-safety.child-access-preve.enact: a firearm shall be stored where a child cannot reach it

justice-public-safety.permit-to-carry-co.subject: a permit to carry a concealed firearm
justice-public-safety.permit-to-carry-co.purpose: set the permit required to carry a concealed firearm
justice-public-safety.permit-to-carry-co.enact: a person who carries a concealed firearm shall hold a permit

justice-public-safety.raise-handgun-purc.subject: a higher age to buy a handgun
justice-public-safety.raise-handgun-purc.purpose: raise the age at which a person may buy a handgun
justice-public-safety.raise-handgun-purc.enact: a person younger than the new age shall not buy a handgun

justice-public-safety.stand-your-ground.subject: the right to stand one's ground
justice-public-safety.stand-your-ground.purpose: remove the duty to retreat before using force in self-defense
justice-public-safety.stand-your-ground.enact: a person in a place they may lawfully be shall have no duty to retreat before using force in self-defense

government-operations.all-mail-voting.subject: voting by mail
government-operations.all-mail-voting.purpose: send every registered voter a ballot by mail
government-operations.all-mail-voting.enact: every registered voter shall be mailed a ballot before each election

government-operations.automatic-voter-re.subject: automatic voter registration
government-operations.automatic-voter-re.purpose: register eligible residents to vote automatically
government-operations.automatic-voter-re.enact: an eligible resident shall be registered to vote unless they decline

government-operations.independent-redist.subject: an independent redistricting commission
government-operations.independent-redist.purpose: have a citizens' commission draw district lines
government-operations.independent-redist.enact: district lines shall be drawn by a commission of residents rather than by elected officials

government-operations.require-photo-id-t.subject: photo identification for voting
government-operations.require-photo-id-t.purpose: require voters to show photo identification
government-operations.require-photo-id-t.enact: a voter shall show photo identification before voting

government-operations.same-day-voter-reg.subject: same-day voter registration
government-operations.same-day-voter-reg.purpose: let residents register and vote on the same day
government-operations.same-day-voter-reg.enact: a resident may register to vote and vote on the same day

government-operations.ban-lobbying-after.subject: a ban on lobbying after leaving office
government-operations.ban-lobbying-after.purpose: bar former officials from lobbying for a time after they leave office
government-operations.ban-lobbying-after.enact: a former official shall not lobby the body they served for the period set here

government-operations.broaden-local-auth.subject: broader local government power
government-operations.broaden-local-auth.purpose: give local governments wider power to govern themselves
government-operations.broaden-local-auth.enact: a local government shall have the power to act on any matter the state has not reserved

government-operations.legislative-term-l.subject: term limits for legislators
government-operations.legislative-term-l.purpose: limit how long a legislator may serve
government-operations.legislative-term-l.enact: a legislator shall not serve more than the number of terms set here

civil-family-community.ban-discriminatio.subject: a ban on discrimination in housing and work
civil-family-community.ban-discriminatio.purpose: bar discrimination in housing and in hiring
civil-family-community.ban-discriminatio.enact: no landlord or employer shall refuse a person housing or a job on a ground the law protects

civil-family-community.dedicated-parks-f.subject: dedicated funding for parks
civil-family-community.dedicated-parks-f.purpose: set aside money for parks every year
civil-family-community.dedicated-parks-f.enact: a set share of revenue shall be dedicated each year to parks

civil-family-community.restrict-abortion.subject: limits on abortion
civil-family-community.restrict-abortion.purpose: set limits on when an abortion may be performed
civil-family-community.restrict-abortion.enact: an abortion shall not be performed after the point set here, except as this measure allows

technology-privacy.age-verification-for-.subject: age checks for social media
technology-privacy.age-verification-for-.purpose: require social media sites to check the age of their users
technology-privacy.age-verification-for-.enact: a social media site shall check the age of each user before opening an account

technology-privacy.restrict-government-f.subject: limits on government facial recognition
technology-privacy.restrict-government-f.purpose: limit how government agencies may use facial recognition
technology-privacy.restrict-government-f.enact: a government agency shall not use facial recognition except as this measure allows

technology-privacy.consumer-data-privacy.subject: privacy of consumer data
technology-privacy.consumer-data-privacy.purpose: limit what businesses may do with customers' personal data
technology-privacy.consumer-data-privacy.enact: a business shall not sell or share a customer's personal data without the customer's consent

agriculture-natural-resources.limit-grou.subject: limits on groundwater withdrawal
agriculture-natural-resources.limit-grou.purpose: limit how much groundwater may be pumped
agriculture-natural-resources.limit-grou.enact: no user shall pump more groundwater than the limit set here

agriculture-natural-resources.protect-fa.subject: protection of farmland
agriculture-natural-resources.protect-fa.enact: working farmland shall not be developed except as this measure allows
